children: RenX Enterprises amended its Securities Purchase Agreement and Registration Rights Agreement to enable a second closing and refine registration terms, then completed a $5.66 million second tranche of senior convertible notes and warrants on Aug. 26, 2026. The amendment permits up to $6.7 million of additional notes and warrants, clarifies share registration requirements across initial and second filings, and carves out certain liquidated damages tied to initial registration timing. The second closing delivered approximately $5.4 million in net proceeds, which RenX used to repay its February senior convertible notes at 110% of principal. The moves bolster liquidity, streamline compliance and reduce near-term debt obligations.
